task: Review asynchronous cross-market carbon forecasting for a genuinely distinct learning rule.
primary_conclusion: Historical cross-series information merits a matched predictive-increment experiment; no qualifying new algorithm or learning constraint established by this bounded review.
approved_operations_performed: Read-only public author core source acquisition
Read-only existing data attribution/scope metadata inspection
Write new research notes and provenance in the assigned scratch subdirectory
information_set: For target A query date q: own A records dated <=q; all donor B records dated <q. Same-day donor data excluded independently of row order.
data_definition_limit: EU_REPORTED is a statistical donor with unauthenticated instrument, venue, currency and roll convention; no hard common-asset/one-for-one/no-arbitrage interpretation.
donor_freshness_limit: Existing EU_REPORTED source metadata ends 2024-03-27; no 2025 live donor update can be claimed without separately scoped data.
dependence_limit: EU_REPORTED and EEX are not independent market replicates.
confirmation_policy: EEX 2024 and 2025 remain sealed in this review. Already used 2023 is development; already evaluated Shanghai confirmation is not reclassified as unseen.
suggested_next_action: If root elects an information study, freeze one target/estimand and matched target-only, linear donor, shared-training-only and time-mask controls before fits; do not register a new algorithm from this review.
failure_conditions: A benefit requires donor dates >= target query date.
Matched linear donor controls explain the benefit and removing a new constraint has no distinct effect.
Shared historical training, rather than query-time donor values, explains the gain.
Donor timing/masks alone explain an alleged price-information effect.
Realized future event dates, future availability or future scales are needed as inputs.
The proposed constraint reduces to an existing ECM, continuous filter, set update or routine preprocessing.
Unverified asset identity is necessary for the asserted hard economic constraint.
Stale 2025 donor data or already exposed periods are mislabeled as live or unseen.
